title: Package Hallucination (aka Slopsquatting)
summary: Short explainer of package hallucination (slopsquatting) with USENIX 2025 study figures.

assertions.quote: 19.7% of package references were hallucinated ... 43% of those hallucinations were repeated

verdicts.note: The USENIX Security 2025 study (Spracklen et al.) measured these rates and found many hallucinated names recur, making them registrable attack targets.
